swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A compass can mark several points that are all the same distance from a fixed point without measuring each one separately. Reason (R): Once opened to a fixed gap, a compass keeps that gap the same no matter where its pointed tip is placed.

add.q: Assertion (A): A compass can mark several points that are all the same distance from a fixed point without measuring each one separately. Reason (R): Rotating a shape does not change any of its side lengths or angles, so a rotated square is still a square. Choose the correct option.

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Constructing perpendiculars at both ends of a given side is enough to guarantee that the finished four-sided figure has all angles equal to 90 degrees. Reason (R): A perpendicular to a line always makes a 90-degree angle with that line.

add.q: Assertion (A): To construct square PQRS of side 6 cm, the point S is marked 6 cm from P along the perpendicular to PQ at P. Reason (R): A compass can only be used to draw circles, and never to mark off a fixed length along a straight line. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A rectangle of sides 4 cm and 10 cm cannot be divided into identical squares of side 4 cm without a leftover piece. Reason (R): 10 is not a whole-number multiple of 4.

add.q: Assertion (A): A rectangle of sides 4 cm and 10 cm cannot be divided into identical squares of side 4 cm without a leftover piece. Reason (R): Every square is a rectangle, since a square has all angles equal to 90 degrees and equal sides mean that opposite sides are also equal. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A point that is equidistant from two given points B and C can always be found using a compass alone, without trial and error. Reason (R): An arc of a fixed radius centred at a point marks every point at exactly that distance from it, so two such arcs cross exactly where both distances are satisfied at once.

add.q: Assertion (A): A point that is equidistant from two given points B and C can never be found using a compass alone; trial and error is always required. Reason (R): An arc of a fixed radius centred at a point marks every point at exactly that distance from it, so two such arcs cross exactly where both distances are satisfied at once. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
